wins.label: Data Center Revenue Growth
wins.evidence: Data Center segment revenue increased 69% year-over-year to a record $3.9 billion.

wins.label: EPYC Processor Adoption
wins.evidence: EPYC processor adoption expanded significantly with cloud, Enterprise and supercomputing customers.

wins.label: AI Hardware Roadmap
wins.evidence: We accelerated our AI hardware road map to deliver an annual cadence of new Instinct accelerators.

wins.label: Client Segment Growth
wins.evidence: Client segment revenue increased 58% year-over-year to a record $2.3 billion.

wins.label: Strong Software Ecosystem
wins.evidence: More than 1 million models on Hugging Face now run out of the box on AMD.

risks.label: Gaming Segment Decline
risks.evidence: Gaming segment revenue declined 59% year-over-year to $563 million.

risks.label: Embedded Segment Weakness
risks.evidence: Embedded segment revenue decreased 13% year-over-year to $923 million.

risks.label: Inventory Normalization
risks.evidence: Semi-custom sales declined as expected as Microsoft and Sony focused on reducing channel inventory.

risks.label: Market Competition
risks.evidence: The server market is always a competitive market.

risks.label: Product Transition
risks.evidence: We are going through a little bit of a product transition time frame in the first half of the year.
